description: Agent-based network diffusion model of household program adoption under social influence, marketing, and incentives. Persons interact on a stochastic block model network with homophily; adoption decisions follow a logistic utility with peer norms, marketing exposure, and monetary incentives; churn is allowed.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs and (optionally) lightly rewires the social network with community structure and homophily.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  draw group_shares ~ Dirichlet([dirichlet_alpha]*num_groups)
  assign each agent to a group by group_shares -> agent.neighborhood_group
  for each pair of groups (a,b):
    p = sbm_p_intra if a==b else sbm_p_inter
    add edges between agents in groups (a,b) with probability p, respecting avg_degree_target via thinning
  apply homophily_on_attitude: for each edge (i,j), compute similarity s = 1 - |att_i - att_j|; keep edge with prob min(1, (1 - h) + h*s)
  with probability rewiring_prob, rewire a small fraction of edges uniformly at random
notes: Runs effectively only at t=0; subsequent ticks no-op unless rewiring_prob > 0.
avg_degree_target achieved by Bernoulli thinning after SBM generation.

modules.name: SocialInfluence
modules.description: Computes perceived social signal per agent from neighbors' adoption with memory and saturation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  N_i = neighbors of i in G
  if |N_i| == 0: frac = 0 else frac = mean(adopted[j] for j in N_i)
  sat = 1 - exp(-social_norm_saturation_kappa * frac)
  w = peer_influence_weight_i  # drawn at init from N(peer_influence_weight_mean, sd)
  raw = w * sat
  # memory smoothing
  alpha = 1 - 0.5 ** (1 / influence_memory_half_life_days)
  social_signal_i = (1 - alpha) * last_social_signal_i + alpha * raw
  last_social_signal_i = social_signal_i
notes: Saturation prevents runaway when nearly all neighbors adopt.

modules.name: MarketingIntervention
modules.description: Generates per-agent marketing exposure from budget and targeting; optionally uses observed daily spend.

notes: Exposure scales linearly with spend via marketing_effect_per_$.
Nonadopters receive biased targeting when targeting_bias_toward_nonadopters > 0.

modules.name: IncentivePolicy
modules.description: Computes per-agent incentive values under a budget and targeting policy schedule.

update_rule.pseudocode:
active = (t >= incentive_start_day) and (t <= incentive_end_day)
if not active:
  incentive_value[:] = 0; return
per_cap_offer = incentive_amount
eligible = [i for i in agents if not adopted[i]]
if incentive_targeting_strategy == 'universal': targets = eligible
elif incentive_targeting_strategy == 'need_based':
  targets = [i for i in eligible if income_quantile_i in ['Q1','Q2'] and rank_quantile(i) <= need_based_income_threshold]
else: targets = random_sample(eligible, int(len(eligible) * 0.5))
# enforce budget
max_affordable = floor(incentive_budget_remaining / per_cap_offer)
assigned_targets = targets[:max_affordable]
for i in agents: incentive_value_i = per_cap_offer if i in assigned_targets else 0
incentive_budget_remaining -= per_cap_offer * len(assigned_targets)
notes: Budget carries over day-to-day within the active window.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Updates adoption state via logistic probability combining social, marketing, and incentives, minus perceived cost.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i where not adopted[i]:
  u = logistic_intercept
  u += beta_social * social_influence_i
  u += beta_marketing * (marketing_exposure_i * sensitivity_marketing_i)
  u += beta_incentive * (incentive_value_i * sensitivity_incentive_i)
  u -= perceived_cost_i
  u += Normal(0, adoption_heterogeneity_scale)
  p = base_adoption_rate + (1 - base_adoption_rate) * sigmoid(u)
  adopt_now = Bernoulli(p)
  if adopt_now:
    adopted[i] = True
    event.new_adopter[i] = True
    time_since_adoption[i] = 0
  else:
    event.new_adopter[i] = False
for each agent i where adopted[i]: time_since_adoption[i] += 1
# adaptive learning of perceived_cost (optional small update)
perceived_cost_i = max(0, perceived_cost_i - learning_rate * social_influence_i)
notes: Base rate prevents total stagnation in absence of signals.

modules.name: Churn
modules.description: Allows adopted agents to abandon adoption (churn), with elevated risk after incentives end and decaying over time.

update_rule.pseudocode:
active_incentives = (t >= incentive_start_day) and (t <= incentive_end_day)
mult = 1.0 if active_incentives else post_incentive_churn_multiplier
lambda_decay = ln(2) / churn_decay_half_life_days
for each agent i where adopted[i]:
  p_churn = baseline_churn_prob * mult * exp(-lambda_decay * time_since_adoption[i])
  c = Bernoulli(min(1.0, p_churn))
  if c: adopted[i] = False; event.churned[i] = True; time_since_adoption[i] = 0 else: event.churned[i] = False
notes: Multiplier increases churn risk immediately after incentives end.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables from agent states and events.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = population_size
adoption_rate_daily[t] = mean(adopted)
new_adoptions_daily[t] = sum(event.new_adopter)
churn_rate_daily[t] = sum(event.churned) / max(1, sum(adopted) + sum(event.churned))
if t == 0: cumulative_adopters[t] = sum(adopted)
else: cumulative_adopters[t] = cumulative_adopters[t-1] + new_adoptions_daily[t] - sum(event.churned)
# optional smoothing
if smoothing_window_days > 1: apply moving average to reported series
notes: Smoothing optional and controlled by parameter.

algorithms.SBM_network_generation: Stochastic Block Model with Dirichlet group shares and Bernoulli edge sampling; post-hoc homophily-thinning and degree-thinning to match targets.
algorithms.Social_signal_saturation: sat(frac) = 1 - exp(-kappa * frac) with exponential smoothing using half-life.
algorithms.Logistic_adoption: p = base + (1-base) * sigmoid(intercept + beta_social*S + beta_marketing*M + beta_incentive*I - cost + noise).
algorithms.Budget_constrained_incentives: Assign per-cap incentives to eligible targets up to remaining budget; deduct spent.
algorithms.Churn_with_tenure_decay: Daily churn probability decays exponentially with tenure; multiplier when incentives inactive.
